name: Daily MA5 single-step slope
purpose: Source-bound existing research output; factor effectiveness unvalidated
formula_text: Completed-session MA5 minus previous completed-session MA5
missing_policy: Preserve missing values and source/provenance gaps; never fill zero

name: Intraday distance from completed-day MA5 / ATR5
purpose: Source-bound existing research output; factor effectiveness unvalidated
formula_text: (Existing current price - completed-day MA5) / completed-day ATR5
missing_policy: Preserve missing values and source/provenance gaps; never fill zero

name: Intraday change relative to QQQ
purpose: Source-bound existing research output; factor effectiveness unvalidated
formula_text: Existing stock change_pct minus aligned qualified QQQ change_pct
missing_policy: Preserve missing values and source/provenance gaps; never fill zero

name: Same-time cumulative RTH RVOL20
purpose: Source-bound existing research output; factor effectiveness unvalidated
formula_text: Current completed RTH cumulative volume / median same-time cumulative volume of 20 complete comparable sessions
missing_policy: Preserve missing values and source/provenance gaps; never fill zero

name: Daily current volume / prior20 mean volume

name: Daily prior20 dollar liquidity

name: RTH cumulative HLC3 VWAP approximation
